title.zh: FrameFlow · 跨浏览器 WebGPU/WebGL2 光流插帧与超分训练推理套件
title.en: FrameFlow · Cross-Browser WebGPU & WebGL2 AI Frame Interpolation and Super-Resolution Suite

summary.zh: 面向浏览器与网页模拟器（如 PVSSPW、PPSSPW）的帧流工作流套件（含 GameFI 光流插帧与 GameSR 2× 超分），提供训练、蒸馏、导出与零依赖 WebGPU/WebGL2 双后端运行时。
summary.en: Browser and web-emulator neural video processing suite featuring GameFI optical-flow frame interpolation and GameSR 2x super-resolution with zero-dependency WebGPU/WebGL2 runtimes.

zh: 零依赖、零 WASM 纯 ES Module 双后端运行时，优先 WebGPU Compute 并自动回退至 WebGL2 Fragment Shader 覆盖全浏览器
支持共享外部 GPUDevice / WebGL2RenderingContext 零拷贝接入 PVSSPW 与 PPSSPW，并内置无阻塞 2x/3x 帧节拍器与可串联超分流程
提供 GameFI-Std（775K，1.52 MB）/ GameFI-Lite（222K，434 KB）插帧双档位与 GameSR-Std（11.5K，22.6 KB）/ GameSR-Lite（6.9K，13.5 KB）2× 超分双档位
与 PyTorch 数值对齐均达 > 60 dB PSNR，内置 100% 开放许可数据切分与云端 GPU 训练发版流水线
en: Zero-dependency, zero-WASM pure ES module runtime prioritizing WebGPU Compute with automatic WebGL2 Fragment Shader fallback across browsers
Supports zero-copy shared GPUDevice and WebGL2RenderingContext integration for PVSSPW and PPSSPW with a non-blocking 2x/3x frame pacer and chainable super-resolution
Includes GameFI-Std (775K, 1.52 MB) / GameFI-Lite (222K, 434 KB) interpolation models and GameSR-Std (11.5K, 22.6 KB) / GameSR-Lite (6.9K, 13.5 KB) 2x SR models
Verified > 60 dB PSNR numerical parity against PyTorch with clean open-licensed data preparation and automated cloud GPU release pipelines

milestone.zh: 已完成 GameFI（Std/Lite）与 GameSR（Std/Lite）训练、双后端数值对齐、Release 权重发布，并已接入 PVSSPW 与 PPSSPW 模拟器。
milestone.en: GameFI (Std/Lite) and GameSR (Std/Lite) models are trained, parity-verified across WebGPU and WebGL2, published via GitHub Releases, and integrated into PVSSPW and PPSSPW.
